title.narrative: UNICEF advanced Mongolia&39;s child-sensitive social protection by fostering child-friendly local governance and evidence-based policies. Engaging Parliamentarians, Ministries and local governments, it addressed systemic gaps and bringing child related deprivations into center of policy dialogues and attention. By leveraging national and subnational budget, encouraging localized strategies, UNICEF advocated resilient, inclusive policies.
